query: Patient is female, 86. Among female inpatients age 81–91 with AKI, compare medication complexity score distribution and outcomes for those with both CNS‑depressant and nephrotoxic drugs versus other AKI patients. Report quartiles, mean complexity, overall LOS and mortality, and top‑quartile LOS and mortality.
final_sql: SELECT akidata_q.subject_id, (akidata_q.q3 - akidata_q.q1) AS interquartile_range, AVG(akidata.los) AS average_los, SUM(CASE WHEN akidata.deathtime IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(akidata.subject_id), 0) AS mortality_rate, (SELECT los FROM admissions WHERE subject_id = akidata_q.subject_id ORDER BY los DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_los FROM akidata JOIN akidata_q ON akidata.subject_id = akidata_q.subject_id GROUP BY akidata_q.subject_id;
